description: Use this when someone asks when a patient is booked, what is booked on a day or what a patient still has to schedule, or needs an appointment id to move, cancel or book it. Returns up to 50 appointments in start order (id, patient and provider ids, times, status, edit time) for one day or one patient, led by that patient's unscheduled ones (TO_SCHEDULE). Not for counting how busy days are, nor for procedures, notes or clinical details.

clinicId.description: Only this practice; every practice of the account when absent

endTime.description: End of the window. Without a patientId at most one day after the start, and one day by default; with one at most a year, and 90 days by default

patientId.description: Only this patient, by the id find_patient returns

startTime.description: Start of the window as an ISO 8601 time with the practice's UTC offset; defaults to now

name: list_appointments

appointments.description: Appointments in start order, canceled ones included, that the signed-in account can view. With a patientId, the patient's appointments still to schedule (status TO_SCHEDULE, no times yet) come first, whatever the window. Procedures, notes, findings, treatments and patient names are never returned.

endTime.description: Null for an appointment still to schedule (TO_SCHEDULE)

lastEditTime.description: The version reschedule_appointment and cancel_appointment check

providerIds.description: The list_clinic_providers ids of the staff booked on it

startTime.description: Null for an appointment still to schedule (TO_SCHEDULE)

status.description: TO_SCHEDULE is a visit the dentist planned that has no date yet; reschedule_appointment books it

hasMore.description: More appointments fall in the window, or are still to schedule, than were returned

title: Find appointments
